# Create interventions.csv

## #1 Load Packages

```{r}
library(here)
library(survminer)
library(stringr)
library(survival)
```

## #2 Import Data

```{r}
ITP <- read.csv(here("results","table_ITP_Lifespan_Data.csv"))
```

```{r}
ITP$sex[ITP$sex=="f"]="Female"
ITP$sex[ITP$sex=="m"]="Male"
```

## #3 Intervention Groups

```{r}
treatment_list=unique(ITP$group)
```

## #4 Calculate Kaplan-Meier Median

```{r}
kaplan_meier = survfit(Surv(age, flag_censura) ~ group + sex, data = ITP)

kp = surv_median(kaplan_meier)
```

## #5 Create Table 

### #5.1 Add Kaplan-Meier Median

```{r}
interventions=data.frame()

for (row in 1:nrow(kp)){
  treatment = str_extract(kp$strata[row], "(?<=group=)[^,]+(?=,)")
  sex = str_extract(kp$strata[row], "(?<=sex=)[^,]+(?=)")
  n = kaplan_meier$n[row]
  median_value = kp$median[row]
  interventions=rbind(
    interventions,
    data.frame(
    Intervention = treatment,
    Sex = sex,
    N = n,
    Median = median_value))
}
```

```{r}
cox = coxph(Surv(age, flag_censura) ~ group + sex, ITP)

cox
```
